svg.title: Lord of Perfected Work: Four of Wands · Venus in Aries · Chesed (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Venus above the painting and Aries below, as Book T places them: "Above and below are two small flaming wands, with the symbols of Venus and Aries representing the Decan." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/grammars/1793139570163-i3qz2guhuc.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
